caption: The drawing depicts a rectangular chest with a curved lid. The chest is decorated with a floral and geometric pattern in shades of green, yellow, red, and beige. The main body appears to be a muted green, with ornate flower motifs outlined in yellow and filled with red accents. The front face of the chest features a metal escutcheon in the center, which is silver or gray, and shaped with a keyhole in the middle. The decorative pattern extends across the top, front, and visible side surfaces of the chest. The edges and corners of the chest are defined with darker lines, enhancing the three-dimensional effect, and the background of the drawing is plain, with a light, slightly yellowed color and a thin black border around the outer edge. The overall composition centers the chest within the bordered frame.
title: Wood Box or Chest
